correctness.rationale: Each transfer is a donor/recipient choice among the two existing part sizes or a new row; an exhaustive six-case analysis proves the explicit union of the hook and two side families and, for all odd sizes at least seven, two exceptional partitions closed under every support-two edge. All members connect through three known chains or a single edge to them. Exact inclusion-exclusion yields sizes. The outsider (n-4,2,2) proves disconnection for all sizes from eight onward; direct small enumeration gives connectivity for sizes three through seven. Independent indexed-row and part-value implementations agree on all support-two vertices sizes three through twenty-two; parametric checks through size 150, not used as an infinite proof.
